ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 import try from dw::Runtime output application/java var tx = vars.originalTransaction var useEventTs = (p('velocity.useEventTimestamp') as Boolean) var allowedBands = ["HIGH", "MEDIUM", "LOW"] fun isNonBlankString(v) = (v is String) and (trim(v) != "") fun looksLikeCardNumber(v) = (v is String) and (v matches /^(\d[ \-]?){13,19}$/) fun asObj(v) = if (v is Object) v else {} fun validHit(h) = (h is Object) and isNonBlankString(h.ruleCode) and isNonBlankString(h.ruleName) and (h.ruleWeight is Number) var txn = asObj(tx.transaction) var card = asObj(tx.card) var customer = asObj(tx.customer) var merchant = asObj(tx.merchant) var device = asObj(tx.device) --- if (tx == null) ["Request body must be a JSON object"] else flatten([ (if (not isNonBlankString(tx.eventId)) ["eventId is required and must be a non-empty string"] else []), (if (not isNonBlankString(tx.correlationId)) ["correlationId is required and must be a non-empty string"] else if (sizeOf(tx.correlationId) > 128) ["correlationId must be at most 128 characters"] else []), (if (not (tx.transaction is Object)) ["transaction object is required"] else []), (if (not isNonBlankString(txn.transactionId)) ["transaction.transactionId is required and must be a non-empty string"] else []), (if (not (txn.amount is Number)) ["transaction.amount is required and must be a number"] else []), (if (not isNonBlankString(txn.currency)) ["transaction.currency is required and must be a non-empty string"] else []), (if (not (tx.card is Object)) ["card object is required"] else []), (if (not isNonBlankString(card.cardToken)) ["card.cardToken is required and must be a non-empty string"] else if (looksLikeCardNumber(card.cardToken)) ["card.cardToken must be an opaque token, not a card number"] else if (not (card.cardToken matches /^[A-Za-z0-9._:\-]{8,128}$/)) ["card.cardToken must be 8-128 characters: letters, digits, '.', '_', ':' or '-'"] else []), (if (not isNonBlankString(card.maskedCardNumber)) ["card.maskedCardNumber is required and must be a non-empty string"] else if (looksLikeCardNumber(card.maskedCardNumber)) ["card.maskedCardNumber must be masked; full card numbers are not accepted"] else []), (if (tx.cardNumber != null or tx.pan != null or tx.cvv != null or card.cardNumber != null or card.pan != null or card.cvv != null) ["Full card number / CVV fields are not accepted; use card.cardToken and card.maskedCardNumber"] else []), (if (not (tx.customer is Object)) ["customer object is required"] else []), (if (not isNonBlankString(customer.customerId)) ["customer.customerId is required and must be a non-empty string"] else []), (if (not (tx.merchant is Object)) ["merchant object is required"] else []), (if (not isNonBlankString(merchant.merchantId)) ["merchant.merchantId is required and must be a non-empty string"] else []), (if (not isNonBlankString(merchant.merchantCountry)) ["merchant.merchantCountry is required and must be a non-empty string"] else []), (if (not (tx.device is Object)) ["device object is required"] else []), (if (not isNonBlankString(device.geoCountry)) ["device.geoCountry is required and must be a non-empty string"] else []), (if (not (tx.riskScore is Number)) ["riskScore is required and must be a number"] else []), (if (not isNonBlankString(tx.riskBand)) ["riskBand is required (HIGH, MEDIUM or LOW)"] else if (not (allowedBands contains upper(trim(tx.riskBand)))) ["riskBand must be one of HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW"] else []), (if (not (tx.ruleHits is Array)) ["ruleHits is required and must be an array (it may be empty)"] else if (sizeOf(tx.ruleHits filter ((h) -> not validHit(h))) > 0) ["each ruleHits item must contain ruleCode (string), ruleName (string) and ruleWeight (number)"] else []), (if (tx.velocity != null and not (tx.velocity is Object)) ["velocity must be an object when present"] else []), (if (useEventTs and not isNonBlankString(tx.eventTimestamp)) ["eventTimestamp is required when velocity.useEventTimestamp=true"] else if (useEventTs and not ((try(() -> tx.eventTimestamp as DateTime)).success)) ["eventTimestamp must be an ISO-8601 date-time, e.g. 2026-09-11T14:22:07+05:30"] else []) ])

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json var tx = vars.originalTransaction var attempts = (p('retry.maxRetries') as Number) + 1 fun truncate(s: String, n: Number) = if (sizeOf(s) > n) s[0 to n - 1] else s fun redact(s: String) = (s replace /(?i)amqps?:\/\/\S+/ with "[REDACTED_URL]") replace /(?i)(password|passwd|pwd|secret)\s*[=:]\s*\S+/ with "[REDACTED]" var rawReason = ((error.description default "") as String) ++ (if ((error.cause.message default "") != "") (" | " ++ (error.cause.message as String)) else "") --- { eventId: tx.eventId, correlationId: vars.correlationId, errorType: ((error.errorType.namespace default "MULE") ++ ":" ++ (error.errorType.identifier default "UNKNOWN")), errorMessage: "Publish to " ++ vars.targetQueue ++ " failed after " ++ (attempts as String) ++ " attempts: " ++ truncate(redact(rawReason), 300), failureStage: p('dlq.failureStage'), originalPayload: tx, timestamp: (now() as String) }
